```{r}
#| eval: false
jabotR::jabot_download()
```

### Description

Download plant specimen records in Darwin Core Format from any
herbarium collection at [JABOT](https://ipt.jbrj.gov.br/jabot)
hosted by the [Rio de Janeiro Botanical Garden](https://www.gov.br/jbrj/pt-br).

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| herbarium | A vector of specific herbarium acronyms (collection code) in uppercase letters or leave it as NULL to download records for all JABOT herbaria. |
| verbose | Logical, if `FALSE`, a message showing steps when downloading herbarium specimen records will not be printed in the console in full. |
| dir | Pathway to the computer's directory, where the file will be saved. The default is to create a directory named `jabot_download` and the results will be saved within a subfolder named by each searched JABOT-associated herbarium collection. |

### Value

Folder with DwC-A files for an specific or all JABOT-associated herbaria.

### Examples

```r
jabot_download(herbarium = c("AFR", "RB"),
               verbose = TRUE,
               dir = "jabot_download")
```
